tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Return the portfolio owner's public profile: name, role, location, tagline, short bio, long bio, email, website, and avatar URL.

tools.name: list_social_links
tools.title: List social links
tools.description: Return the portfolio owner's public social and contact links (GitHub, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, email).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List public portfolio projects with title, description, tags, category, GitHub URL, and demo URL. Supports optional filtering by category, tag, featured-only, and a text search over title and description.

category.description: Filter by category, e.g. 'AI / ML', 'Quantum Computing', 'Full Stack'.

tag.description: Filter to projects containing this tag (case-insensitive).

featured.description: If true, return only featured projects.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title and description.

tools.name: list_experience
tools.title: List experience
tools.description: List the portfolio owner's work, research, academic, and education experience entries. Optionally filter by type.

type.description: Filter to a single experience type.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.title: List skills
tools.description: Return the portfolio owner's public technical skill groups, each with a set of named skills and self-rated proficiency levels (0–100).

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: Return the services the portfolio owner offers, each with a title and short description.
